story: A cold puppy was on a high ledge. Nora said, “I want to rescue the puppy.” Dad said, “The ladder is in the shed.” Nora lifted the puppy down with the ladder. Nora wrapped the puppy in the warm blanket. The puppy rested in the warm blanket.
